Ranger.effect: Ranged Damage modifications are increased by 50%. You can't equip melee weapons. Max HP modifications are reduced by 25%.

Mage.effect: Elemental Damage modifications are increased by 25%. Melee Damage modifications are reduced by 100%. Ranged Damage modifications are reduced by 100%. Engineering modifications are reduced by 50%.

Chunky.effect: Max HP modifications are increased by 25%. +1% Damage for every 3 Max HP you have. HP Regeneration modifications are reduced by 50%. Dodge modifications are reduced by 50%. Speed modifications are reduced by 100%.

Lucky.effect: Luck modifications are increased by 25%. +75% chance to deal 1 (+15% Luck) damage to a random enemy when you pick up a material.

Generalist.effect: +2 Melee Damage for every 1 Ranged Damage you have. +1 Ranged Damage for every 2 Melee Damage you have. You can only equip 3 melee weapons and 3 ranged weapons at a time.

Loud.effect: -3 Harvesting at the end of a wave.

Multitasker.effect: You can equip up to 12 weapons at a time. -5% Damage for every weapon you have.

Wildling.effect: +30% Life Steal with Primitive weapons. You can't equip weapons above tier 2.

Pacifist.effect: Gain 0.65 material and XP for every living enemy at the end of a wave.

Gladiator.effect: +20% Attack Speed for every different weapon you have. You can't equip ranged weapons.

Saver.effect: +1% Damage for every 25 Materials you have. Weapon price is also increased by 50%.

Sick.effect: You take 1 damage per second (does not give invulnerability time).

Farmer.effect: Harvesting increases by an additional 3% at the end of a wave. +1 Harvesting when eating a consumable while at full health.

Ghost.effect: +10 Damage with Ethereal weapons. Dodge is capped at 90%.

Speedy.effect: +1 Melee Damage for every 2% Speed you have. -100 Armor while standing still.

Entrepreneur.effect: Harvesting modifications are increased by 50%. Gain 25% more materials from recycling items. -100% of your materials at the start of waves. Damage modifications are reduced by 50%.

Engineer.unlocked_by: Get 5 turrets on the map simultaneously
Engineer.effect: Engineering modifications are increased by 25%. Structures spawn close to each other. Damage modifications are reduced by 50%.

Doctor.effect: +200% Attack Speed with Medical weapons. HP Regeneration modifications are increased by 100%. Armor modifications are reduced by 50%.

Hunter.effect: +1% Damage for every 10 Range you have. Crit Chance modifications are increased by 25%. Harvesting modifications are reduced by 100%. Max HP modifications are reduced by 33%.

Artificer.unlocked_by: Kill 15 Enemies with a single explosion
Artificer.effect: +4% Explosion Size for every 1 Elemental Damage you have. +100% Damage with Tool weapons. Armor modifications are reduced by 50%.

Arms Dealer.effect: Damage modifications are increased by 33%. Shops always sell at least 1 weapon. All of your weapons are destroyed when entering a shop.

Streamer.effect: +3% of your materials per second while standing still (+25 max). +40% Damage while moving. +40% Attack Speed while moving. +2 Armor for every 1 Structure you have. -1% Damage for every 15 Materials you have. -1% Speed for every 30 Materials you have.

Cyborg.unlocked_by: Reach 10 Ranged Damage and get 3 structures at the same time
Cyborg.effect: Ranged Damage modifications are increased by 200%. 100% of your Ranged Damage is temporarily converted into Engineering halfway through a wave (1 Ranged Damage = 2 Engineering). Engineering modifications are reduced by 75%. Melee modifications are reduced by 100%. Elemental modifications are reduced by 100%.

Glutton.unlocked_by: Pick up 20 consumables during a run
Glutton.effect: +1% Explosion Damage when picking up a consumable while at maximum health. Consumables have a 100% chance to explode for 10 (+500% Melee Damage) damage when picked up.

Jack.unlocked_by: Kill a boss or an elite in less than 15 seconds
Jack.effect: +125% damage against bosses and elites. On higher danger levels, only Elites spawn, never hordes.

Lich.effect: 100% chance to deal 10 (+100% Max HP) damage to a random enemy when you heal. Damage modifications are reduced by 50%.

Apprentice.effect: +2 Melee Damage when you level up. +1 Ranged Damage when you level up. +1 Elemental Damage when you level up. +1 Engineering when you level up. -2 Max HP when you level up.

Cryptid.unlocked_by: Finish a wave with 10 or more living trees
Cryptid.effect: More trees spawn (+6). Gain 12 material and XP for every living tree at the end of a wave. +3 HP Regeneration for every current living tree. Dodge is capped at 70%. +3 Attack Speed until the end of the wave when you dodge an attack.

Fisherman.effect: Shops always sell a Bait. -100% Bait price. +2 Harvesting for every 1 Bait you have. Baits make some special enemies spawn throughout all future waves.

Golem.effect: Max HP modifications are increased by 33%. Armor modifications are increased by 33%. +40% Attack Speed when you have less than 50% health. +20% Speed when you have less than 50% health. You can't heal in any way.

King.unlocked_by: Get 3 tier IV weapons at once
King.effect: +25% Damage for every Tier IV weapon you have. +25% Attack Speed for every Tier IV weapon you have. +5 Max HP for every different Tier IV item you have. -15% Damage for every Tier I weapon you have. -15% Attack Speed for every Tier I weapon you have. -2 Max HP for every different Tier I item you have. UNLISTED BONUS: Starting weapon is Tier II.

Renegade.unlocked_by: Get 10 different tier I items during a run
Renegade.effect: +2 projectiles. Projectiles pierce through 1 additional target. +10% Damage for every different Tier I item you have. You can't equip melee weapons. -400% Damage. -50% accuracy. % Damage modifications are reduced by 80%.

One Armed.effect: Damage modifications are increased by 100%. You can only equip one weapon at a time.

Bull.effect: HP Regeneration modifications are increased by 50%. You explode for 30 (+300% Melee Damage +300% Ranged Damage +300% Elemental Damage) damage when you take damage. This explosion has a 1.5x crit multiplier. You can't equip weapons.

Soldier.effect: +50% Damage while standing still. +50% Attack Speed while standing still. You can't attack while moving.

Masochist.effect: +5% Damage when you take damage until the end of the wave.

Knight.effect: +2 Melee Damage for every 1 Armor you have. You can't equip ranged weapons. You can only equip tier 2 weapons or above. % Attack Speed modifications are reduced by 50%. Harvesting modifications are reduced by 80%.

Demon.effect: +50% of your Materials are converted into Max HP at the end of a wave (13 Materials = 1 Max HP). You buy items using Max HP instead of materials.

Baby.effect: You gain a weapon slot when you level up instead of a stat upgrade (max: 24). You start with one weapon slot. Shops always sell at least one weapon. +130% XP required to level up.

Vagabond.effect: Equipped weapons always contribute to the class bonuses of other equipped weapons. You can't equip two of the same weapon at the same time. Luck modifications are reduced by 50%. Harvesting modifications are reduced by 50%.

Technomage.unlocked_by: Reach 10 Elemental Damage and get 3 structures at the same time
Technomage.effect: +5% Structure attack speed for every permanent 1 Elemental Damage you have. +2 Elemental Damage for every 1 Structure you have. +75% XP required to level up. Melee Damage modifications are reduced by 100%. Ranged Damage modifications are reduced by 100%.

Vampire.effect: +2% Damage for every 1% of missing health. +1% Life Steal for every 3% of missing health. +1 Armor for every 5% of missing health. Max HP modifications are reduced by 25%.

Beast Master.unlocked_by: Unlock the Catling Gun, Bonk Dog, Bot-O-Mine, Blazemander and Lootworm items
Beast Master.effect: You can't equip weapons. +2% Speed for every permanent 1 Pet you have. Pet damage also scales with Melee Damage, Ranged Damage, Elemental Damage, and Engineering.

Wounded.unlocked_by: Win a run in Nightmare difficulty
Wounded.effect: This character dies in One Hit. Shop items and crates are cleared of items focusing on Max HP, HP Regeneration, % Life Steal and Armor.

Sailor.effect: +200% damage with Naval weapons against cursed enemies. You can only equip tier II weapons or above. Dodge is capped at 20%. Harvesting modifications are reduced by 100%.

Curious.effect: 2 additional loot aliens appear every wave. All future loot aliens become stronger when you kill a loot alien. +2% XP Gain for every different Item you have. -10% Damage for every duplicate item or weapon you have.

Builder.effect: Every 5 uncollected materials are converted into 1% Structure attack speed and 1 Structure Range at the end of a wave. Engineering modifications are increased by 50%. You can't have structures. Damage modifications are reduced by 75%.

Captain.effect: +60% XP Gain for every free weapon slot you have. +100% stats gained from level upgrades. +200% XP required to level up. +2% Enemy health at the end of a wave. +2% Enemy damage at the end of a wave.

Creature.effect: Weapon damage additionally scales with 35% Curse. +1 Curse when you level up. -10 Range at the end of a wave. -5% XP Gain at the end of a wave.

Chef.unlocked_by: Have at least 25 enemies burning at the same time
Chef.effect: +200% damage from non elemental sources against burning targets. Consumables explode for 5x1 (+100% Elemental Damage) burning damage when picked up. Elemental Damage modifications are reduced by 75%.

Druid.unlocked_by: Collect 250 consumables by the end of wave 20
Druid.effect: Enemies have a higher chance of dropping fruits. 33% chance to get +1 Luck when you pick up a fruit. 33% of fruits are poisoned and hurt you (ignores Dodge and Armor). Engineering modifications are reduced by 50%.

Dwarf.unlocked_by: Hit at least 25 enemies with a single melee attack
Dwarf.effect: +1 Engineering when killing at least 6 enemies with a direct weapon hit. +1 Melee Damage for every permanent 2 Engineering you have. You can't equip ranged weapons. % Attack Speed modifications are reduced by 50%.

Gangster.unlocked_by: Reroll 10 times in a single shop
Gangster.effect: Can steal 1 item per shop. Stealing from the shop can spawn an elite. All future elites and bosses become stronger when you kill an elite or a boss. Can't lock items.

Diver.unlocked_by: Kill 1000 enemies that are more than 700 range away from you
Diver.effect: -100% Harpoon Gun price. +200% Crit Damage with Precise weapons. % Crit Chance modifications are increased by 25%. +1 HP Regeneration for every 2 Melee Damage you have. Enemies take 300% more damage for 3 seconds when hit by Ranged Damage.

Hiker.effect: Earn 5 materials for every 10 steps you take during a wave. +1 Max HP for every 80 steps you take during a wave. % Speed modifications are increased by 10%.

Buccaneer.effect: Picked up materials have +100% value. Picking up a material resets the cooldown of all your weapons.

Ogre.unlocked_by: Deal 1000 damage to an enemy in a single hit
Ogre.effect: Enemies taking double their max health as damage explode for 10 (+50% Max HP -50% Attack Speed) damage. You can't equip ranged weapons.

Romantic.effect: Hitting an enemy that has less than 25% health has a 5% (+50% Max HP) chance to charm it for 8 seconds. +50 Range with melee weapons. -3% Damage for every 5 Curse you have. -1 Armor for every 5 Curse you have. +1 Curse at the end of a wave.
